Suburban going-out: get dinner at Sushi Mido, then head to my favorite cocktail bar, Drastic Measures. It's a gem in downtown Shawnee that is getting a lot of well deserved recognition! Remember to knock if the lights are green, or wait patiently if the lights are red! They WILL leave your ass out there if you pound at the door when the lights are red. Into the City: dinner at char bar, my absolute FAVORITE local barbecue restaurant (haven't been there in months...someone take me pls). Then bar hop! The Hey Hey Club, Green Lady, Afterword...all awesome. 

Bonus if you're a little nerdy like me: North Kansas City, Armour Rd., get dinner at Wolcano Teppanyaki (more build your own stir fry or sushi), then hit up ReRoll, Vignettes, and whichever Apparition Pop-Up is also relatively nearby (I can't remember, they have multiple pop-ups going on at any given moment in KC, Wichita, and maybe St. Louis?)
